proposition: The repository should derive a static reader site from a constrained semantic model while keeping Markdown as the auditable source of truth.
minority_view: A direct Quarto or MkDocs migration would offer broader syntax sooner if dependency preservation stopped being a requirement.
unknowns: Future syntax growth may make the bounded parser less economical than a pinned external parser.
weighting_method: Weight fixed implementation architecture and repository compatibility above feature count or attention.
conditions: Applies to the current standard-library, Markdown-first repository and its observed GFM subset.
limitations: No full migration prototype was benchmarked against the lightweight implementation.
reversal_criteria: Reverse if real suite fixtures require broad Markdown semantics that cannot be safely supported without an external parser.

proposition: Useful report interaction changes inspection or navigation while leaving a complete non-interactive reading path.
minority_view: Highly exploratory data applications may legitimately make interaction central rather than optional.
unknowns: The task includes no user study measuring comprehension of the resulting site.
weighting_method: Use peer-reviewed interaction design evidence and preserve its scoped task conditions.
conditions: Applies to prose-led technical reports where parameters are not the primary artifact.
limitations: Evidence studies authoring and multiverse reports, not this exact technology-frontier suite.
reversal_criteria: Reverse if the report's central object becomes an executable model that cannot be understood without manipulation.

proposition: A large research suite needs explicit suite, page, and focus navigation states rather than a single global table of contents.
minority_view: A short single-page report may need only headings and browser find.
unknowns: The best default collapse state for each reader path remains a visual QA question.
weighting_method: Prioritize repeated implementation convergence and authoritative accessibility guidance.
conditions: Applies to the current 56-page suite and similar multi-file reader packages.
limitations: No controlled comparison of navigation variants was performed.
reversal_criteria: Reverse if the suite collapses to a small single document or user testing shows the extra layers increase disorientation.

proposition: Technical relationships should be rendered from structured or parseable source into a visual view plus searchable text and inspectable evidence context.
minority_view: Static images can be sufficient when the source is externally maintained and has complete alt text.
unknowns: Full Mermaid grammar coverage is explicitly unresolved.
weighting_method: Prefer representations that preserve author source, search visibility, and non-visual fallback.
conditions: Applies to diagrams and comparisons that encode report mechanisms rather than decorative illustrations.
limitations: The selected systems use different markup and evidence models.
reversal_criteria: Reverse if build-time rendering demonstrably distorts diagrams more than a pinned browser runtime and no offline requirement remains.
